page.notes: The Arabic words in the line "quia peregrini ... Arabes" and in "facti; ut Sabæi ... Arabes nati" are not legible letter by letter at this scan size, so they are marked illegible. The number "6ıc" after "Christi" is read as 610 and is doubtful. The "42" may be a superscript 2 after the 4, printed as "4²". The first word of the page, "tia", is a fragment from the previous page and is kept as printed. The line "defcriptu." is also a fragment that continues from the previous page.
